samples.title: Burst flexi hose
samples.why: Clear covered claim: sudden burst hose, policy in force and paid, under $20k, no emergency, vulnerability or catastrophe flags, high confidence.
checks: Escape of liquid (B5 / C3); plumber confirms no prior leak, so the gradual-damage exclusion D1 does not apply
Hose itself not covered, but it was not claimed

samples.title: Creek flood, flood cover removed
samples.why: Decline: the assessor shows creek overflow (Flood, B3), not storm, and endorsement E07 removes flood cover. The customer is displaced and a regional event is flagged, so a senior handler confirms the decline with written reasons (G4).
checks: Customer describes it as "storm and water damage"
Water came from Leycester Creek at ground level; no roof or storm damage
Endorsement E07 removes Flood cover (C9) and triggers exclusion D2

samples.title: Apartment theft, high value
samples.expectedSettlement: Up to $23,198 if everything is accepted
samples.why: Over the $20k high-value threshold, with handler judgement needed: possibly unlocked balcony door (E12), no forced entry, late notification, and items over sub-limits without proof of ownership.
checks: Police report within 24h (C4(ii)) likely met, but the event number needs verifying
Necklace and watch capped at $3,000 each (E1), no proof of ownership (F4); cash capped at $500 (E3)
Outstanding: police confirmation, proof of ownership, strata CCTV, how entry was gained
